title: Certifications and Continuous Learning: A Simple Track

cover.alt: Conceptual learning path unfolding from a book through practice and hands-on experimentation.

figures.title: Practice, inspect the gap, and test again
figures.summary: The study method linked questions to documentation and practical exposure.

items.label: Practice
items.detail: Attempt a practice exam without notes.

items.label: Inspect misses
items.detail: Identify which concept or service caused confusion.

items.label: Use a reference
items.detail: Read official documentation or a focused explanation.

items.label: Apply the idea
items.detail: Connect the concept to work in a guided lab.

items.label: Retest
items.detail: Check whether the gap is actually closed.

figures.caption: The study loop described by the author; no exam specifications or current passing requirements are reproduced.

figures.title: Familiarity is useful; ownership is a separate claim
figures.summary: The article draws a boundary between knowledge gained and experience not established by a credential.

items.label: Navigation
items.detail: Practiced: finding services and reading configuration. Not established: managing large production environments.

items.label: Troubleshooting
items.detail: Practiced: tracing lab failures. Not established: handling live customer incidents.

items.label: Permissions
items.detail: Practiced: understanding roles and actions. Not established: designing enterprise-wide access strategy.

items.label: Delivery
items.detail: Practiced: sustained study and completion. Not established: senior engineering judgment or project ownership.

figures.caption: A qualitative responsibility boundary from this article, not a ranking of certifications.
